security.operatorAuthentication: existing operator allowlist; derive worker on server
security.authoringSession: server-issued session bound to operator, pipeline, allowed run or current DRAFTED supply scope; expiry enforced
security.storageIdentity: server-calculated SHA, decode and read-back only
security.downloadUrl: transient secret; do not persist in provenance or logs

tools.name: prepare_authoring_sources
requires: shared V5 normalizer used by actual image sync

tools.name: persist_authoring_source
requires: only one URL or file input
safe DNS/redirect/size checks for source URL
official file URL host and DNS policy for file input
native evidence validated in Authoring scope when applicable
actual Storage read-back SHA and decode

tools.name: get_authoring_source_supply
requires: owned active session or read-only owned completed receipt

tools.name: resume_authoring_source_supply
requires: current DRAFTED or equivalent nonpublished allowed state
no conflicting active source session or modified/claimed Task

tools.name: bind_authoring_source
requires: Task row and relevant supplies locked
atomic retire of previous selected input and binding of new input
doesNot: reuse old authoring run as an active lease

tools.name: complete_authoring_v2
requires: single DB transaction for existing completion + sync + source binding
doesNot: silently extend v1 allowed package keys
force existing Tasks into new policy

tools.name: dispatch_visual_supplied_source
requires: same Task/current hash and selected bound supply
doesNot: accept caller path or replacement URL

implementationNotes: This is a logical API contract, not runtime JSON Schema. Implement complete inputSchema/fileParams and server validation together.
A native file reference that cannot be downloaded is not an asset. Keep failed supply and exact transport code.
After DRAFTED source-only resume, use a separate atomic bind operation under its supply session; do not replay complete_authoring_v2 with a modified package.
The source-only bind operation must lock current Task, reject conflicting active claims, compare current hash, bind the new supply, and return readiness.
After approval, the normal active Reviewer claim has ended; publication authorization comes from approval snapshot and a new Publisher lease.
A publish request that lost its response is queried before redispatch. Native platform safety blocks are not bypassed.
